'''Ishenn''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] who was employed by [[Thaddeus Ross]] and [[Trep Winterrs]] to lead a diplomatic security detail. Ishenn failed to protect the [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] they were assigned to protect.<ref name="LAD" />
